name: Shigatsu Youka
source:
April. Comes the season where cherry blossoms dance and waft along the wind——

In one city, a crimson red corpse was discovered. It was in an outright horrendous state of sheer atrocity. Whether it be television, or the Internet and social media, discussions surrounding it blew up, and it had became a trending matter. As for what prompted such heated attention? It was due to the fact that numerous cases of similar circumstances have already occured several times in the past.

What should have been just an unrelated matter through screens and media, is what they had presumed, seemed to have started transpiring around these few girls, and a certain "something" was wriggling in the dark right by them.

[Translated from [url=https://freegame-mugen.jp/adventure/game_7817]Freem![/url]]
translation:
四月。樱花随风翩翩起舞的季节到来了——

在一座城市中，发现了一具赤红色的尸体。这是一种完全可怕的暴行状态。无论是电视，还是网络、社交媒体，围绕它的讨论炸开了锅，成为了热门话题。到底是什么引起了如此热烈的关注呢？这是因为类似情况的案例在过去已经发生过很多次。

本来应该通过屏幕和媒体无关的事情，却是他们所推测的，似乎已经开始在这几个女孩周围发生，某种“东西”就在她们身边的黑暗中蠕动。
